question: Change one end of a steel bar. When does the far end feel it?
answer: The far end responds a very, very short time later, not at the same instant. The change at one end is a signal that must travel, and in steel that time is tiny but never zero.
move: Even in a rigid steel bar, a signal takes a finite time to get from one end to the other.

web.label: A steel bar with one end changed. The reader picks when the far end responds: at the same instant, a very short time later, long enough to watch it wait, or a very, very short time later.

source: Veritasium, “Does a Falling Slinky Defy Gravity?” (YouTube, 2012)
